Summary table of all the runs of a project

Source: R/nm_runs_table.R
nm_runs_table.Rd

Builds one table with one row per run of a project and, when output_file is given, writes it to a Word document. Each run is shown with its description (text of $PROBLEM), the run it was derived from (its parent, read in the control stream as in nm_model_diagram()), its OFV, the change of OFV from its parent and from the best run, its number of estimated parameters, its AIC and BIC, its minimisation and covariance status, its largest ETA shrinkage and the share of parameters estimated with a relative standard error above 50%.

Usage

nm_runs_table(
  x,
  parents = NULL,
  sort = c("tree", "ofv", "run"),
  output_file = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  title = "Summary of the runs",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

Result of nm_extract_runs(), or the path of an analysis directory, which is then read with nm_extract_runs(x).

parents

Optional links that complete or replace those read in the control streams, as in nm_model_diagram(): a named character vector (c(run2 = "run1")) or a data frame with columns run and parent.

sort

Order of the rows: "tree" (default; each run right after its parent, as in nm_model_diagram()), "ofv" (best OFV first) or "run" (run names, numbers sorted as numbers).

output_file

Path of the Word file (.docx). NULL (default): nothing is written.

overwrite

Logical. Replace an existing output_file (default FALSE).

title

Title written above the table in the Word file.

verbose

Print a message when the file is written.

Value

An object of class nm_runs_table: a data frame with one row per run and the columns run, description, parent, ofv, dofv_parent (OFV of the run minus OFV of its parent), dofv_best (minus the lowest OFV of the project), n_par, aic, bic, minimization, covariance, max_eta_shrink (%), pct_rse_gt50 (% of the parameters with an RSE above 50%) and status (as in nm_model_diagram()). The Word file, when written, has the same rows in landscape format; its path is kept in the attribute output_file.

See also

nm_extract_runs(), nm_model_diagram(), nm_compare_runs(), nm_extract_run_table() (table of the estimates of one run)

Examples

ex <- system.file("extdata", "example", package = "nmpilot")
tab <- nm_runs_table(ex, parents = c(run2 = "run1"))
tab
#> Summary of 2 run(s)
#>  Run  Parent OFV      dOFV (parent) dOFV (best) N par AIC     BIC    
#>  run1        -1147.34               76.69       8     -1131.3 -1097.0
#>  run2 run1   -1224.04 -76.69        0.00        10    -1204.0 -1161.1
#>  Covariance Max shrinkage (%) RSE > 50% (%)
#>  COMPLETED  14.7              0.0          
#>  COMPLETED  14.4              0.0          
# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("officer", quietly = TRUE)) {
  f <- file.path(tempdir(), "runs_summary.docx")
  nm_runs_table(ex, parents = c(run2 = "run1"), output_file = f, overwrite = TRUE)
}
#> Word file written: /tmp/Rtmp4BwTni/runs_summary.docx
#> Summary of 2 run(s)
#>  Run  Parent OFV      dOFV (parent) dOFV (best) N par AIC     BIC    
#>  run1        -1147.34               76.69       8     -1131.3 -1097.0
#>  run2 run1   -1224.04 -76.69        0.00        10    -1204.0 -1161.1
#>  Covariance Max shrinkage (%) RSE > 50% (%)
#>  COMPLETED  14.7              0.0          
#>  COMPLETED  14.4              0.0          
#> Word file: /tmp/Rtmp4BwTni/runs_summary.docx 
# }
